pt: Uma mesa para dois, por favor.
alternatives: Uma mesa para dois, se faz favor.
Por favor, uma mesa para dois.

example.pt: Boa noite. Uma mesa para dois, por favor.
example.en: Good evening. A table for two, please.

note: O *prato do dia* = the dish of the day.

example.pt: O prato do dia é bacalhau.
example.en: The dish of the day is salt cod.

example.pt: O peixe aqui é muito fresco.
example.en: The fish here is very fresh.
I don't eat meat.
Would you like dessert?

note: Said to a waiter. To a friend: O que recomendas?

example.pt: Não sei o que escolher. O que recomenda?
example.en: I don't know what to choose. What do you recommend?

note: A woman says *vegetariana*.

example.pt: Desculpe, sou vegetariano. Tem pratos sem carne?
example.en: Excuse me, I'm vegetarian. Do you have dishes without meat?

pt: Pode trazer a conta, se faz favor?
en: Could you bring the bill, please?
alternatives: Pode trazer a conta, por favor?
Se faz favor, pode trazer a conta?

example.pt: Estava tudo ótimo. Pode trazer a conta, se faz favor?
example.en: Everything was great. Could you bring the bill, please?

note: Said about a meal. *Estava* is a past form of estar; learn it as a phrase for now.

example.en: Thanks, it was very good!

example.pt: Um copo de vinho tinto, por favor.
example.en: A glass of red wine, please.
Excuse me, how much is this coat?

note: What you ask at the till for the total.

example.en: How much is it, please?
The shop opens at nine.
I'm going to the supermarket.

example.pt: A farmácia fica ao lado do banco.
example.en: The chemist's is next to the bank.

note: *Cara* with feminine words: a *casa é cara*.

example.en: This restaurant is very expensive.

note: *Barata* with feminine words: a *fruta é barata*.

example.en: Bread is cheap here.

note: Estar a + verb is what you're doing right now. Women say *obrigada*.

example.pt: Posso ajudar? Estou só a ver, obrigado.
example.en: Can I help? I'm just looking, thanks.
Excuse me, can I pay by card?

note: At the till you may hear: *Quer saco*? (Do you want a bag?)

example.en: Do you want a bag? No, thanks.
I don't have cash, only a card.

note: To a friend: segue *em frente*.

example.pt: Siga em frente e vire à esquerda.
example.en: Go straight on and turn left.

note: To a friend: *vira à direita*.

example.en: At the traffic lights, turn right.
Is the beach far from here?

note: de + o = do, de + a = da: *ao lado da farmácia*.

example.pt: O café fica ao lado da farmácia.
example.en: The café is next to the chemist's.
The bank is on the corner.
We'll meet in the square.

example.pt: Apanho o metro para o trabalho.
example.en: I take the metro to work.

note: A *paragem de autocarro* = the bus stop.

example.pt: A paragem fica em frente ao hotel.
example.en: The stop is opposite the hotel.

pt: Como é que chego à estação?
en: How do I get to the station?
note: *Como é* que…? is a very common way to start a question in Portugal.

example.pt: Desculpe, como é que chego à estação?
example.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?

pt: Fica a cinco minutos a pé.

example.pt: O museu? Fica a cinco minutos a pé.
example.en: The museum? It's five minutes' walk.

note: *Mapa* ends in -a but is masculine: o *mapa*.

example.en: Do you have a map of the city?

note: Also means a quarter: *um quarto de hora*.

example.en: My bedroom is small.
We're in the kitchen.

note: Short for *sala de estar*.

example.en: The TV is in the living room.
Where's the key?

example.pt: Durante a semana, acordo às sete.
example.en: During the week, I wake up at seven.

en: I have a shower in the morning.
note: *Tomar banho* = to have a shower or a bath.

example.pt: Tomo banho de manhã e à noite.
example.en: I shower in the morning and at night.

note: *Sair* (to leave, to go out) is irregular: *eu saio*.

example.pt: Normalmente saio de casa às oito.
example.en: I usually leave home at eight.

note: In Portugal: *chegar a casa* (to get home).

example.pt: Chego a casa às seis e janto às oito.
example.en: I get home at six and have dinner at eight.

example.pt: Faço o jantar todos os dias.
example.en: I make dinner every day.

example.pt: Estou cansado, vou para a cama.
example.en: I'm tired, I'm going to bed.

note: *Ao fim de semana* = at the weekend.

example.pt: Ao fim de semana durmo até tarde.
example.en: At the weekend I sleep in.

note: Often just *segunda*. Days of the week don't take a capital letter.

example.en: On Monday I'm going to the doctor.

note: Often just *sexta*.

example.en: On Friday we're going out for dinner.
On Saturday I'm going to the beach.

note: *Ao domingo* = on Sundays (every Sunday).

example.pt: Ao domingo almoço com a minha família.
example.en: On Sundays I have lunch with my family.

note: *Para a semana* = next week, very common in Portugal.

example.pt: Para a semana vou a Lisboa.
example.en: Next week I'm going to Lisbon.
Are you free tomorrow afternoon?

en: Shall we go for a coffee?

example.pt: Estás livre? Vamos tomar um café?
example.en: Are you free? Shall we go for a coffee?
Shall we have dinner tomorrow? At what time?

note: What you say once a plan is agreed.

example.en: At eight at the café? It's a deal!
In the evening I watch TV.

note: And *à tarde* = in the afternoon.

example.pt: Trabalho de manhã e estudo à tarde.
example.en: I work in the morning and study in the afternoon.
